tl.title: Inanunsyo na ang English Release ng Adachi and Shimamura Volume 13!
tl.text: Ang English edition ng Adachi and Shimamura Volume 13 ay ilalabas sa North America sa Oktubre 20, 2026, na ilalathala ng Airship. Ang 224-pahinang light novel ay nagtatampok ng kuwento at sining nina Hitoma Iruma, raemz, at Non. Ang volume, na pinamagatang "Putting on a Show," ay sumusunod kina Adachi at Shimamura bilang mga third-year student na kahit papaano ay tuluyang nakalimot tungkol sa Culture Festival hanggang sa maimbitahan silang lumahok. Bagama't ilang araw lamang tatagal ang event, mukhang may ibang bagay na nasa isip si Adachi.

en.title: Adachi and Shimamura Volume 13 Announced for English Release!
en.text: The English edition of Adachi and Shimamura Volume 13 is set to go on sale in North America on October 20, 2026, published by Airship. The 224-page light novel features story and art by Hitoma Iruma, raemz, and Non. Titled "Putting on a Show," the volume follows Adachi and Shimamura as third-year students who somehow completely forgot about the Culture Festival until they were invited to participate. Although the event will only last a couple of days, it seems Adachi has something a little extra in mind.

tl.title: Inanunsyo na ang Volume SS3!
tl.text: Ang ikatlong collection ng mga short story ng Adachi to Shimamura ay ilalabas sa Japan sa Setyembre 10. Kasama ng "Her Memories," na sumusunod sa isang paglalakbay na ginawa nilang dalawa bilang mga university student, naglalaman ang volume ng maraming bagong kuwentong tungkol sa kanilang pang-araw-araw na buhay sa bahay, sa supermarket, at maging sa ibang bansa.

en.title: Volume SS3 Announced!
en.text: Adachi to Shimamura's third short story collection goes on sale in Japan on September 10. Alongside "Her Memories," which follows a trip the two take as university students, this volume includes many newly written stories about their everyday life at home, at the supermarket, and even overseas.

tl.title: Inanunsyo na ang Volume 9 ng Adachi and Shimamura manga!
tl.text: Ang ikasiyam na volume ng Adachi and Shimamura manga adaptation ay iginuhit ni Moke Yuzuhara, batay sa orihinal na kuwento ni Hitoma Iruma, at nagtatampok ng character designs ni Non. Ilalabas ito sa Japan sa Oktubre 27, 2026.

en.title: Adachi and Shimamura Manga Volume 9 Announced!
en.text: The ninth volume of the Adachi and Shimamura manga adaptation, illustrated by Moke Yuzuhara and based on the original story by Hitoma Iruma, with character designs by Non, will be released in Japan on October 27, 2026.
